nodes.label: Cross-Midnight Service Night
nodes.rationale: For venues open past midnight (e.g. 12:00–03:00), times after midnight belong to the next calendar day but the same service night; resolveBookingInstantUtcMs and getResolvedCalendarDate advance the calendar date when slot minutes fall at or below openTo.

nodes.label: Cross-Midnight Opening Window
nodes.rationale: When openFrom > openTo, valid times are those at or after openFrom OR at or before openTo, modeling overnight lounge hours instead of a same-day interval.

nodes.label: Telegram Hostess Notification Flow
nodes.rationale: Successful bookings are not stored in-app; POST /api/booking formats an HTML Telegram message with a short requestId so the hostess confirms by Telegram or phone.

nodes.label: Client-Server Slot Validation Parity
nodes.rationale: BookingForm filters selectable times with filterBookableSlots while the API re-checks isSlotBookable on submit so users cannot bypass the 1.5-hour advance rule or opening-hours constraints.

nodes.label: Graphify Agent Pre-Tool Hooks
nodes.rationale: PreToolUse hooks inject graphify guidance when agents run grep/find-style Bash or read code files, steering queries toward graphify-out/ instead of raw file grepping when a knowledge graph exists.

nodes.rationale: Server-side validation enforces venue operating window before accepting bookings.

nodes.rationale: Discrete rubric: EXTRACTED=1.0; INFERRED picks 0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55; AMBIGUOUS 0.1-0.3.

nodes.label: Node ID Format stem_entity
nodes.rationale: Immediate parent dir + filename stem + entity; must match AST extractor IDs to avoid ghost duplicates.

nodes.label: Post-Commit Hook
nodes.rationale: Re-runs AST on changed code files after each git commit; doc/image changes require manual --update.

nodes.label: save-result Feedback Loop
nodes.rationale: Saves Q&A back into graph so next --update extracts answers as nodes.

nodes.label: build_merge
nodes.rationale: Merges incremental extraction into existing graph while preserving edge direction and hyperedges.

nodes.rationale: When only code files changed, skip LLM semantic extraction and run AST-only update.
